name: Labeled Link
abstract: Schema for a labeled link, implemented as a profile of schema.org/CreativeWork: a resolvable URL with an optional name and description. Optionally carries the DCAT relation surface for a link that expresses a typed relationship. Absorbed the cdifDataType/cdifReference block on 2026-09-23, which was this schema plus exactly these two optional properties. Defines properties: @type, schema:name, schema:description, schema:url, dcat:hadRole, dcterms:relation. Uses building blocks: cdifConceptOrTermOrString (cdifDataType).
